controllerFindings.whyNotShippedForL5: Every measured fix reshuffles the deterministic escort timeline: with the fix set, G-13 high seed 1 passed (0.98) but seeds 2/3 moved to 0.927/0.917; the low band worst rose 89.85 -> 93.31 while the high band (previously PASS 96.86-100%) regressed to mia 91.07 / dale 93.05, the low G-13 clause (previously PASS ~0.973) regressed to 0.9108 (the improved group median inflates the relative bar), and qa:threat gained 5 L5 flags (SLOW_FOLLOWER:28, passive STUCK_CHASER x2). The strict relative aggregates (>=95% band share per follower, >=0.95x group median, 2-of-3 seed votes) cannot be met by the steering fixes alone: the residual is the turn/reversal transient pool (corner-cut swings and restart ramps cost 20-65 out-of-band ticks per occurrence to whichever follower eats them). Per the lane's no-regression clause the L5-affecting changes were reverted; the classes above are the measured map for the orchestrator's next decision (escort redesign: damped slot heading/parking-behind at stops, or the s167 tolerance proposal).
